name: Piekart for WooCommerce
author: DataShastra

sections.description:
Piekart for WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store to Piekart’s Transportation Management
System (TMS) for order fulfillment and delivery tracking.

How it works

  • Enter your Piekart credentials under WooCommerce → Settings → Piekart.
  • When an order reaches “Processing” (WooCommerce’s paid / ready-to-fulfill state, for both
    prepaid and Cash on Delivery orders), the plugin sends the order to Piekart automatically.
  • Piekart’s TMS calls back into this site as the shipment progresses (shipped → in transit →
    delivered), and the plugin updates the order’s tracking info and status accordingly.
  • Cancelling a synced order in WooCommerce automatically sends a cancellation to Piekart.

Third-party service disclosure

This plugin is a connector for Piekart (https://piekart.in), a third-party delivery/logistics
platform, and requires an active Piekart merchant account to do anything useful — it is not a
standalone shipping solution. Merchant accounts and API credentials are provisioned directly by
Piekart’s team (there is no self-service sign-up); see “Where do I get Piekart API credentials?”
below. To function, it transmits the following order and customer data to Piekart’s API:

  • Order ID, order number, and line items (SKU, description, quantity, weight, price)
  • Customer name, phone number, and shipping/billing address
  • Order total and payment type (Cash on Delivery vs. prepaid)

This data is sent only for orders that reach the “Processing” status, and only after a merchant
has entered the Piekart account credentials issued to them under WooCommerce → Settings →
Piekart — no data is transmitted before the plugin is configured.

Piekart Privacy Policy: https://piekart.in/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin directly through the WordPress admin’s “Plugins → Add New” screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active — the plugin will show an admin notice and stay
    inactive otherwise.
  4. Contact Piekart at https://piekart.in to get onboarded as a merchant. There is no
    self-service sign-up — Piekart’s team provisions your tenant ID, user ID, and API
    credentials directly in their backend and shares them with you.
  5. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Piekart and enter the Piekart tenant ID, user ID, API
    credentials, sender/warehouse details, and inbound webhook credentials you received.
  6. Give Piekart your site’s status-update webhook URL,
    https://yoursite.com/wp-json/piekart/v1/status-update, along with the same Basic auth
    username/password you configured, so Piekart’s TMS can authenticate when it calls back.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without a Piekart account?

No. This plugin is a connector for Piekart’s delivery/TMS service and requires an active Piekart
merchant account and API credentials to send orders or receive tracking updates.

What triggers an order being sent to Piekart?

The order reaching the “Processing” status in WooCommerce — this covers both Cash on Delivery
orders and prepaid orders once payment is captured, since WooCommerce doesn’t fire a separate
“paid” event the way some other platforms do.

What happens if an order is cancelled?

If the order was already synced to Piekart, the plugin automatically sends a cancellation request
to Piekart when the order’s status changes to “Cancelled” in WooCommerce.

Where do I get Piekart API credentials?

There is no self-service sign-up. Piekart’s team provisions your merchant credentials
(tenant ID, user ID, API username/password, etc.) directly in their backend and shares them
with you once you’re onboarded as a Piekart customer. Contact Piekart at https://piekart.in
to get onboarded and receive your credentials.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Customers now see the delivery status and tracking number on the order page and in order emails.
  • Delivery status and tracking link are now taken from Piekart’s response.
  • Cancellation notes now show Piekart’s reason when an order could not be cancelled.
  • Refreshed the Piekart admin page and settings tab design.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: outbound order sync on “Processing”, inbound status webhook
    (shipped / in transit / delivered), automatic cancellation sync, WooCommerce settings screen,
    and an integration-status admin page.
